# claudoom

Plays Doom-engine WADs in a Claude Code pane: runs doom-cli (GPLv2, built from upstream) in a private tmux server and repaints its frames into a Raster. Fetches Freedoom (BSD) on demand. DOOM is a ZeniMax trademark; not affiliated with id Software, ZeniMax or Anthropic.

## Install

```bash
magus
```

Find `claudoom` on the Plugins tab and turn it on. magus registers the `magus-alpha`
marketplace if you do not have it, and installs what the plugin needs to actually run —
binaries, MCP servers, CLI tools.

For a team, press `s` to save your plugins as a profile and commit it. Everyone else runs
`magus install` — see [Teams and profiles](../../guides/teams.md).

Prefer to do it by hand? [Installing Magus](../../guides/install.md) has the manual path.
